conditional_findings.first_contract: An admitted urban extent needs a defined spatial indexing work and storage bound at the owner that expands patch bounding boxes into cells.
conditional_findings.classification: New current source assessment, conditional on supported extent and producer policy; not a historical unique-count increment.
conditional_findings.trace: SpatialBuckets::new divides each patch bounding box by the 32m bucket size, floors to integer minimum and maximum, then visits every inclusive pair of x/y cells, inserting the patch index. UrbanGroundLookup::new is publicly exposed and eagerly expands every supplied street, yard and building bounding box without a per-patch span or total-cell guard in that implementation. A nondegenerate convex Market with four finite corners at (−1000000,−1000000), (1000000,−1000000), (1000000,1000000), (−1000000,1000000) passes the Market leaf is_valid check. Its coordinates and quotient by32 are exactly representable; the cell indices run from −31250 through31250 on each axis. If the nested loops could complete, one patch entails 62501×62501 = 3906375001 cell insertions. Allocation or resource limits may intervene first. No lookup, allocation, time measurement or input was executed.
conditional_findings.safeguards_and_limits: The scene urban validator caps street count at12000 and checks each leaf, but that cap does not itself constrain the extent of this particular finite Market. TacticalSceneInput also runs other source and grounding validations, and geographic preparation does other fallible work before build_scene_ground constructs UrbanGroundSurfaces; no complete accepted scene or actual producer, performance result, denial of service or user impact has been demonstrated. UrbanGroundSurfaces uses the same constructor when created and reconstructs the skipped lookup lazily after deserialization, subject to upstream data and successful earlier steps. Ordinary city generation may impose smaller extents, which still needs tracing. The prior Segovb632 record explicitly left bounded patch producers and work-cap evidence open; it is preserved without reattributing this new calculation. This large convex example has a different first contract from the prior degenerate-market containment/masking finding and the ground-raster allocation question; exact relationships remain open.
